H1-P4.q: In the villages and families I've spent time around, a lot of the time things go through the extended family and the local memory, alongside the formal systems. Whether it's land, childcare, housing, food, obligations, etc, etc. Who needs a workshop called "Rebuilding Intergenerational Belonging" when some aunt has already given three people a task?
